cards.name: Pale Spark
cards.text: Deal 3 at range 3.
cards.note: Range 2 lost to a step plus a melee card. Range 3 lets the opener hit from safety while staying the weakest spell.

was.name: Dull Bolt
was.text: Deal 4 at range 3.

cards.note: The lowest-scoring starter. Now it is the starter deck's escape from a surround, and it teaches Push on turn one.

was.name: Waning Pulse
was.text: Pulse for 4 on adjacent tiles.

cards.text: Strike for 5, then draw 1.
cards.note: Flagged as a starter but used by no starting kit, reward or shop. Dead data.

was.text: Strike for 5, then draw 1.

was.text: Deal 3 at range 2, then leave Fire and radius-2 Light for 2 turns.

cards.name: Firebrand Volley
cards.text: Deal 4 at range 3. Leave Fire.
cards.note: Was strictly better than Guiding Flare. Drops the Light rider and becomes the fast, plain painter.

was.name: Firebrand Volley
was.text: Deal 4 at range 3, then leave Fire and radius-1 Light for 2 turns.

cards.name: Cinder Bloom
cards.text: Deal 2 in a cross at range 2. Leave Fire in the cross. Empower (Exhaust): the pattern becomes a radius-2 diamond.
cards.note: Time 6 to 5. The wide painter; the once-per-combat Empower paints a whole Detonate board.

was.name: Cinder Bloom
was.text: Deal 2 in a cross at range 2, then leave Fire in the pattern.

cards.name: Hearth Rush
cards.text: Move 2, then strike for 6. Leave Fire beneath the target.

was.name: Hearth Rush
was.text: Move 2, then strike for 6 and leave Fire beneath the target.

cards.name: Cinderline Tempo
cards.text: Deal 2 at range 2, then Detonate 6 at the target.
cards.note: Time 4 to 3. A cash-out that needs setup should be cheap.

was.name: Cinderline Tempo
was.text: Deal 2 at range 2, then Detonate 6 at the impact.

cards.name: Kindle
cards.text: Place Fire on a tile within range 3. Draw 1.
cards.note: The cheapest Fire setup. Lets a hand holding only a Detonate still function.

cards.name: Flame Jet
cards.text: Deal 4 to the first 3 tiles in a line from you (rotatable). Leave Fire on the farthest tile.
cards.note: A close-range line, a shape Fire lacked. The far tile becomes the next Detonate anchor.

cards.name: Scorch
cards.text: Deal 4 at range 3. +3 if the target stands on Fire.
cards.note: Non-consuming payoff: rewards keeping Fire on the board instead of spending it.

cards.name: Stoke
cards.text: Each enemy you can see that stands on Fire takes 3.
cards.note: A wide, non-consuming payoff. Detonate spends Fire; Stoke rewards having lots of it.

cards.name: Ember Ward
cards.text: Gain 5 Block. Leave Fire under each adjacent enemy.
cards.note: Ward cycle. Melee enemies that stay to hit you burn at their turn start.

cards.name: Inferno Ritual
cards.text: Deal 3 in a cross at range 2, then Detonate 9 in that pattern.

was.name: Inferno Ritual
was.text: Deal 3 in a cross at range 2, then Detonate 9 in that pattern.

cards.name: Molten Reach
cards.text: Deal 4 along a 3-tile line at range 2. Leave Fire along it.
cards.note: Time 6 to 5, in line with the other painters.

was.name: Molten Reach
was.text: Deal 4 along a three-tile line at range 2, then leave Fire along it.

cards.name: Cinder Fusillade
cards.text: Flurry. Deal 2 at range 3 and leave Fire, once per play spent.

was.name: Cinder Fusillade
was.text: Flurry. Deal 2 at range 3 and leave Fire for each play spent.

cards.name: Flashsteam
cards.text: Target a cross within range 3. Consume all Ice in it. Deal 3 to each enemy in the cross, +4 to enemies that stood on Ice.
cards.note: Fire + Ice bridge. An Ice player's leftover lanes become a Fire player's ammunition.

cards.name: Magma Vent
cards.text: Consume a Rubble tile within range 3. Deal 5 to each enemy on it and its four neighbors, then leave Fire there.
cards.note: Fire + Earth bridge. Card-level version of what Basalt Kiln does as a relic.

cards.name: Cinder Wall
cards.text: Leave Fire on a 4-tile line within range 2 (rotatable). Gain 4 Block.
cards.note: Defensive Fire: a wall that makes approaching you cost health.

cards.name: Immolation
cards.text: Detonate 8 on every Fire tile within 1 of you, including your own. You take no damage from it. Empower (2 HP): within 2 instead.
cards.note: The firewalker's burst. Stand in your own Fire, then cash all of it out at once.

cards.name: Pyroclasm
cards.text: Deal 9 at range 3. If the target stands on Fire, consume it and deal 6 more.
cards.note: Fire's single-target nuke, conditional on the element's own setup.

cards.name: Rite of the Pyre
cards.text: Rite: your Fire tiles deal 2 more damage.
cards.note: Fire's engine piece. Every painter after this one is worth more.

cards.name: Meteorfall
cards.text: Mark a 3-tile line within range 4 (rotatable). At the start of your next turn, each marked tile takes 8 and becomes Fire.
cards.note: Vyraketh's marks, turned around. A telegraphed strike that controls where enemies are willing to stand.

cards.name: Wildfire Halo
cards.text: Deal 4 in a large diamond at range 2, then Detonate 10 in that pattern.

was.name: Wildfire Halo
was.text: Deal 4 in a large pattern at range 2, then Detonate 10 in that pattern.

cards.name: Salamander Heart
cards.text: Rite: you ignore Fire damage. At the start of your turn, if you stand on Fire, gain 3 Stoneskin and draw 1.
cards.note: Build-around. Turns Fire from a shared hazard into your terrain.

cards.name: Frostbolt
cards.text: Deal 4 Ice at range 3. Leave Ice.

was.name: Frostbolt
was.text: Deal 4 Ice damage at range 3, then leave Ice.

was.name: Rime Shard
was.text: Deal 2 Ice damage along a two-tile line at range 2, then leave Ice.

was.text: Strike up to range 2 for 7 Ice damage.

was.text: Pierce for 6 Ice damage at range 3.

cards.name: Frost Lane
cards.text: Leave Ice on a 3-tile line within range 3 (rotatable). Draw 1.
cards.note: Pure lane painter. Enemies that walk it are Chilled on entry.

cards.name: Skate
cards.text: Move 3. This turn, Ice costs you no movement and doesn't Chill you.
cards.note: Ice mobility. Your own lanes become roads for you and traps for them.

cards.name: Shiver Shot
cards.text: Deal 2 Ice at range 4.
cards.note: The cheapest Freeze trigger. Ice needed a fast card to convert Chilled into Frozen.

cards.name: Hoarfrost Ward
cards.text: Gain 5 Block. Leave Ice under each adjacent enemy.
cards.note: Ward cycle. Enemies that stay adjacent start their turn Chilled for your next Ice hit.

cards.name: Rimefang
cards.text: Deal 4 Ice at range 2. Follow-up: +3, and leave Ice.
cards.note: Rewards playing it second; played second after a painter, it can Freeze.

cards.name: Hush of Winter
cards.text: Deal 5 Ice at range 4. If this Freezes the target, draw 2.
cards.note: Was a top-5 score with no identity (6 damage + draw). Now it pays you for doing the Ice setup.

was.name: Hush of Winter
was.text: Deal 6 Ice damage at range 4, then draw 1.

cards.name: Shatterline
cards.text: Deal 5 Ice along a 3-tile line at range 2. Pierce. Empower (+2 Time): the line is 5 tiles.
cards.note: Time 7 to 6, plus an optional long line.

was.name: Shatterline
was.text: Pierce a three-tile line for 5 Ice damage at range 2.

cards.name: Glacier Pin
cards.text: Deal 3 Ice along a 2-tile line at range 2 and Immobilize. Leave Ice.
cards.note: Already Ice's best setup: pinned enemies can't walk off their Ice before it Chills them.

was.name: Glacier Pin
was.text: Deal 3 Ice damage along a two-tile line at range 2 and immobilize. Leave Ice in the line.

cards.name: Icebound Chains
cards.text: Deal 5 Ice at range 2 and Immobilize. Gain Truesight for 2 turns.

was.name: Icebound Chains
was.text: Deal 5 Ice damage at range 2 and immobilize. Gain truesight for 2 turns.

cards.name: Prism Sight
cards.text: Gain Truesight for 2 turns and 4 Block. Draw 1.

was.name: Prism Sight
was.text: Gain truesight for 2 turns, gain 4 block, and draw 1.

cards.name: Frost Circuit
cards.text: Choose an Ice tile within range 3. It and all Ice connected to it become Electrified. Deal 2 Lightning to each enemy on them and Shock them.
cards.note: Ice + Lightning bridge. Converts frozen lanes into a live network.

cards.name: Sleet Squall
cards.text: Push 2 at range 3, then deal 3 Ice to the target.
cards.note: Ice + Air bridge. Push first, hit second: a target shoved onto Ice is Chilled on entry, so the hit Freezes it.

cards.name: Ice Sculpture
cards.text: Create a 4-health illusion within range 3. Leave Ice on each empty tile adjacent to it.
cards.note: A decoy that is also a trap. Enemies that step up to hit it arrive Chilled.

cards.name: Frost Nova
cards.text: Deal 4 Ice to each adjacent enemy. Leave Ice on all 8 tiles around you.
cards.note: Paints a whole ring at once. Pairs with Skate and Hoarfrost Wall.

cards.name: Shatter
cards.text: Deal 5 Ice at range 3. If the target was Frozen, also deal 5 to each enemy adjacent to it.
cards.note: The Freeze payoff that spreads: 15 to the Frozen target, shards to its neighbors.

cards.name: Rite of Hoarfrost
cards.text: Rite: whenever you Freeze an enemy, gain 3 Block and draw 1.
cards.note: Ice's engine. Each Freeze now refunds a card.

cards.name: White Silence
cards.text: Deal 4 Ice to each Chilled enemy you can see. (Each is Frozen.)
cards.note: Was 10 damage at range 3, a big number and nothing more. Now it is the Ice capstone: a mass Freeze for a prepared board.

was.name: White Silence
was.text: Deal 10 Ice damage at range 3.

cards.name: Crystal Mantle
cards.text: Exhaust. Gain 3 Mantle. Each direct hit against you breaks one Mantle instead of dealing damage.
cards.note: Iskaldra's armor for the player. It negates hits by count, so it answers boss strikes that Block can't.

cards.name: Spark Dart
cards.text: Deal 4 Lightning at range 3. Leave Electrified and radius-1 Light for 2 turns.

was.name: Spark Dart
was.text: Deal 4 Lightning damage at range 3, then leave Electrified and radius-1 Light for 2 turns.

cards.note: Time 5 to 4, plus an Empower. Lightning should be the fast element.

was.name: Chain Bolt
was.text: Deal 4 Lightning damage with Chain 2 at range 3.

cards.text: Leave Electrified on a 3-tile line within range 3 (rotatable). Draw 1. Gain 1 Vision for 2 turns.

was.name: Spark Focus
was.text: Place a three-tile Electrified line at range 3, draw 1, then gain 1 Vision for 2 turns.

cards.name: Static Lash
cards.text: Deal 4 Lightning at range 3. Hits conducted through Electrified also Shock.
cards.note: Time 6 to 4. A conditional common can't cost more than an unconditional rare.

was.name: Static Lash
was.text: Deal 4 Lightning damage at range 3. Electrified-assisted hits also Shock.

cards.name: Jolt
cards.text: Deal 2 Lightning at range 3.
cards.note: The one-Time zap. Finishes a wounded enemy for the kill play, or pokes a network.

cards.name: Static Rush
cards.text: Move 2. Quicken 2.
cards.note: Reposition and make the next card cheaper.

cards.name: Capacitor
cards.text: Gain 4 Block. Your next Lightning attack this turn gains Chain 2.
cards.note: Setup card that turns any single bolt into a multi-target one.

cards.name: Static Ward
cards.text: Gain 5 Block. Electrify your tile and the tile of each adjacent enemy.
cards.note: Ward cycle. Your tile links the adjacent tiles, so the next bolt hits everyone around you.

cards.name: Arc Flash
cards.text: Deal 3 Lightning at range 3. Follow-up: Chain 2.

cards.name: Storm Relay
cards.text: Deal 5 Lightning at range 3. Chain 2. Hits conducted through Electrified also Shock.

was.name: Volt Surge
was.text: Deal 3 Lightning damage along a three-tile line at range 2, then leave Electrified.

cards.text: Deal 3 Lightning at range 3. Chain 2. Leave Electrified and radius-2 Light for 2 turns at the impact.

was.name: Storm Beacon
was.text: Deal 3 Lightning damage with Chain 2 at range 3, then leave Electrified and radius-2 Light for 2 turns at the impact.

cards.name: Overclock
cards.text: Draw 1. Gain 1 card play. Empower (1 HP): draw 2 instead.
cards.note: Lightning's card-flow piece, with a blood option for the big turn.

cards.name: Plasma Arc
cards.text: Deal 3 Lightning at range 3. Chain 2. Each enemy hit that stands on Fire takes 4 more; consume that Fire.
cards.note: Lightning + Fire bridge.

cards.name: Thunderclap
cards.text: Deal 3 Lightning to each adjacent enemy and Push them 1. Electrify your tile.
cards.note: Lightning + Air bridge. A shockwave that clears space and leaves a conductor behind.

cards.name: Storm Salvo
cards.text: Flurry. Deal 2 Lightning at range 3 with Chain 1, then draw 1, once per play spent.

was.name: Storm Salvo
was.text: Flurry. Deal 2 at range 3 with chain 1, then draw 1, for each card play spent.

cards.name: Thunderline
cards.text: Deal 6 Lightning along a 3-tile line at range 2. Chain 1. Hits conducted through Electrified also Shock.
cards.note: Legendary to epic, Time 8 to 7. Strong, but it doesn't change how you play.

was.name: Thunderline
was.text: Deal 6 Lightning damage along a three-tile line at range 2 with Chain 1. Electrified-assisted hits also Shock.

cards.name: Discharge
cards.text: Choose an Electrified tile within range 4. Deal 5 Lightning to each enemy on or adjacent to its connected network, then remove the network.
cards.note: Cash in the wiring. Ordinary Lightning keeps the network; Discharge spends it for a bigger area.

cards.name: Ball Lightning
cards.text: Create a 3-health illusion within range 3 and Electrify its tile. Enemies that damage it take 4 Lightning and are Shocked.
cards.note: A decoy that punishes whoever takes the bait.

cards.name: Rite of the Storm
cards.text: Rite: at the start of each of your turns, deal 2 Lightning to each enemy standing on Electrified.
cards.note: Makes wiring worth doing even on turns you don't attack.

cards.name: Tempest Form
cards.text: Rite: your cards cost 1 less Time (minimum 1).
cards.note: Build-around for the turn clock. Pays for itself in about three turns, so it is strongest in long fights.

cards.name: Skybolt
cards.text: Deal 7 Lightning to any enemy you can see, ignoring range and line of sight. It conducts; everything it hits is Shocked.
cards.note: Zekarion's strike in the player's hand. The only card that ignores sight lines.

cards.text: Move 3. Gain 2 Vision for 2 turns.

was.name: Dawnstep
was.text: Move 3, then gain 2 vision for 2 turns.

was.text: Move 3. Create radius-1 Light where you arrive for 2 turns, then draw 1.

was.text: Move 1, then Pull 2 at range 2 for 3 damage.

was.name: Slipstream Cut
was.text: Move 2, then strike for 5 and Push 1.

cards.name: Updraft
cards.text: Push 2 at range 3 for 3.
cards.note: 1 less damage. Driving the target into a wall, crate or another enemy now adds up to 4 to each of them.

was.name: Updraft
was.text: Push 2 at range 3 for 4 damage.

cards.name: Buffet
cards.text: Push 1 at range 2 for 2.
cards.note: A cheap nudge: one tile onto a trap or Fire, or 2 collision damage against a wall.

cards.name: Crosswind
cards.text: Deal 3 at range 3 and Push 2 in any direction.
cards.note: Sideways force. Uses the engine's existing sideways-force flag (Quarry Winch's aiming) without the Rubble cost.

cards.name: Hurricane Palm
cards.text: Strike for 3 and Push 3.
cards.note: The big shove. Against a wall or another enemy, the collision adds up to 6 to each.

cards.name: Gale Ward
cards.text: Gain 5 Block. Push each adjacent enemy 1.
cards.note: Ward cycle. Disengage without spending a move.

cards.name: Wind Shear
cards.text: Deal 3 along a 3-tile line at range 2 and Push each target 1 away from you. Empower (+2 Time): Push 2 instead.

cards.name: Vacuum Line

cards.note: Time 7 to 6.

was.name: Vacuum Line
was.text: Pull 3 at range 3 for 6 damage, then draw 1.

was.name: Squall Shot
was.text: Deal 4 in a rotatable pattern at range 2 and Push 1.

cards.name: Razor Gale

was.name: Razor Gale
was.text: Flurry. Deal 2 at range 2 and push 1 for each card play spent.

cards.text: Swap places with a one-tile enemy or one of your illusions within range 3.
cards.note: The positional classic the pool lacked: put them where you were, on your hazards.

cards.name: Fan the Flames
cards.text: Push 2 at range 3 for 2. Leave Fire on each tile the target passes through.
cards.note: Air + Fire bridge. Draws a Fire line with the enemy's own body.

cards.name: Dust Devil
cards.text: Consume a Rubble tile within range 3. Push each enemy adjacent to it 2 away from it. Expose 2.
cards.note: Air + Earth bridge.

cards.name: Kestrel Dive
cards.text: Blink 3, then strike an adjacent enemy for 5 and Push 1.
cards.note: Air's melee: drop in from above and knock the target into something.

cards.name: Vortex
cards.text: Choose a tile within range 3. Pull each enemy within 2 of it 2 tiles toward it.
cards.note: Gathers a group for an area attack, the opposite of Squall. Each enemy stops next to the tile or level with it; one pulled into another enemy collides.

cards.name: Eye of the Storm
cards.text: Gain 6 Block. Until your next turn, enemies that hit you in melee are Pushed 2.
cards.note: A Retaliate variant: the answer to being surrounded.

cards.name: Rite of Tailwinds
cards.text: Rite: gain 1 extra independent movement each turn. Your Push and Pull move targets 1 tile farther.

cards.name: Skybreak Current
cards.text: Deal 4 at range 4 and Push 5.
cards.note: Was Updraft for 3 more Time (6 damage, Push 2). Now a real legendary: launch one enemy across the room. Stopped after one tile, it deals 8 more to the target and to what it hit.

was.name: Skybreak Current
